{
  "coverage": [
    {"reason":"Purpose and investor-protection context; creates no separate approval test.","status":"CONTEXT","unit_id":"d97b56331f41a.u0.2"},
    {"reason":"Establishes UCITS post-authorisation scope, home-supervision context and immediate-effect language.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d97b56331f41a.u1.190"},
    {"reason":"Heading identifying the subject of the measures.","status":"CONTEXT","unit_id":"d97b56331f41a.u2.523"},
    {"reason":"Limits the listed measures to post-authorisation matters.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d97b56331f41a.u3.575"},
    {"reason":"Separate operator-change measure; its express supervision condition is not automatically imported into the investment-change test.","status":"CONTEXT","unit_id":"d97b56331f41a.u4.653"},
    {"reason":"Supplies the selected approval-relief rule, home-requirements condition and product/local-policy exceptions.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d97b56331f41a.u5.840"},
    {"reason":"Separate notification measure; approval relief does not establish satisfaction of notice requirements.","status":"CONTEXT","unit_id":"d97b56331f41a.u6.1221"},
    {"reason":"Identifies operative supporting FAQs, forms and checklists absent from the packet.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d97b56331f41a.u7.1419"},
    {"reason":"Implementation heading.","status":"CONTEXT","unit_id":"d97b56331f41a.u8.1677"},
    {"reason":"Supplies the express effective date.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d97b56331f41a.u9.1696"},
    {"reason":"Preserves existing processing for qualifying pending applications.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d97b56331f41a.u10.1809"},
    {"reason":"Management-company heading; does not itself specify an additional duty.","status":"CONTEXT","unit_id":"d97b56331f41a.u11.2030"},
    {"reason":"Preserves post-vetting and possible enquiries or regulatory action despite prior-approval relief.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d97b56331f41a.u12.2069"},
    {"reason":"Provides a clarification channel, without defining the substantive test.","status":"CONTEXT","unit_id":"d97b56331f41a.u13.2377"},
    {"reason":"Issuing-division identification.","status":"CONTEXT","unit_id":"d97b56331f41a.u14.2489"},
    {"reason":"Issuer identification.","status":"CONTEXT","unit_id":"d97b56331f41a.u15.2518"},
    {"reason":"Defines the geographically restricted UCITS population for this circular.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d97b56331f41a.u17.2556"},
    {"reason":"FAQ reference identified; linked contents are unavailable and their interpretation is deferred.","status":"DEFERRED","unit_id":"d97b56331f41a.u18.2831"},
    {"reason":"Forms/checklists reference identified; linked contents are unavailable and their interpretation is deferred.","status":"DEFERRED","unit_id":"d97b56331f41a.u19.2914"}
  ],
  "dimensions": [
    {
      "dimension":"scope",
      "explanation":"The selected control concerns material investment changes to already authorised funds within the circular's UCITS definition. Management companies are the operational audience; the SFC is the approving and post-vetting authority. The operator-change and notification measures are separate.",
      "source_unit_ids":["d97b56331f41a.u1.190","d97b56331f41a.u3.575","d97b56331f41a.u4.653","d97b56331f41a.u5.840","d97b56331f41a.u6.1221","d97b56331f41a.u11.2030","d97b56331f41a.u17.2556"],
      "status":"PROPOSED"
    },
    {
      "dimension":"definitions",
      "explanation":"UCITS is expressly limited to the four named EU domiciles and UK-domiciled schemes authorised as UK UCITS. Materiality, novel or complex features, home requirements and potential local policy implications are not defined in the supplied text.",
      "source_unit_ids":["d97b56331f41a.u5.840","d97b56331f41a.u17.2556"],
      "status":"AMBIGUOUS"
    },
    {
      "dimension":"exceptions",
      "explanation":"The exception attaches to removal of prior approval. Novel features, complex features or possible local policy implications each suffice to withhold that relief. Home-requirements compliance is a prerequisite. Failure of either test does not independently establish the underlying approval duty from this packet.",
      "source_unit_ids":["d97b56331f41a.u5.840"],
      "status":"PROPOSED"
    },
    {
      "dimension":"modality",
      "explanation":"The operative measure removes a prior-approval requirement for qualifying changes. It does not approve the change, excuse home-law compliance or remove post-vetting. Post-vetting is stated to continue; follow-up enquiries and regulatory actions are discretionary possibilities.",
      "source_unit_ids":["d97b56331f41a.u5.840","d97b56331f41a.u12.2069"],
      "status":"PROPOSED"
    },
    {
      "dimension":"time",
      "explanation":"The express date is 28 November 2025. The proposal reads 'immediate effect' consistently with that date, although the packet supplies no circular issue date. Pre-effective-date applications remaining unapproved follow the existing process; the precise assessment time for their pending status is unstated.",
      "source_unit_ids":["d97b56331f41a.u1.190","d97b56331f41a.u9.1696","d97b56331f41a.u10.1809"],
      "status":"AMBIGUOUS"
    },
    {
      "dimension":"dependencies",
      "explanation":"Implementation is expressly located in relevant FAQs. Those contents, related forms/checklists, applicable home requirements and the existing approval process are unavailable. Dependency identifiers missing.1c25ffdf5c1e10e0297748d5 and missing.79fb54125bb1f35a1d457fad have no supplied contents or explicit mapping to particular references.",
      "source_unit_ids":["d97b56331f41a.u5.840","d97b56331f41a.u7.1419","d97b56331f41a.u9.1696","d97b56331f41a.u10.1809","d97b56331f41a.u18.2831","d97b56331f41a.u19.2914"],
      "status":"AMBIGUOUS"
    }
  ],
  "questions": [
    "What conditions or classifications do the revised FAQs impose on this particular investment change?",
    "What existing approval rule governs a change excluded from relief, and does it require prior approval in the specific case?",
    "Does the transition preserve only processing of the pending application, or also prevent withdrawal and use of the new relief for the same change?",
    "When is pending status assessed, and what date governs a change planned before but implemented after 28 November 2025?",
    "How do the relevant home requirements and SFC guidance classify materiality, product novelty or complexity, and possible local policy implications?"
  ],
  "readings": [
    {
      "assumptions": [
        "This is a proposal for the circular's stated relief conditions, subject to the unavailable FAQs; it is not a determination of legal correctness.",
        "The specific effective date governs the general immediate-effect wording.",
        "A qualifying application received before the Effective Date and still unapproved at that date stays within the existing process for the selected application.",
        "The exception is disjunctive: novelty, complexity or possible local policy implications independently defeats relief.",
        "Home-supervision language explains the measures; no separate supervision condition is added to item (ii) beyond its express home-requirements condition."
      ],
      "citations": [
        {
          "quote":"The key streamlined measures cover the following post-authorisation matters:",
          "unit_id":"d97b56331f41a.u3.575"
        },
        {
          "quote":"Removing the SFC’s requirement on prior approval for material changes in investment objectives, policies and restrictions which comply with the fund’s home jurisdiction requirements, except for changes that involve novel or complex product features and/or which may have local policy implications.",
          "unit_id":"d97b56331f41a.u5.840"
        },
        {
          "quote":"For this circular, UCITS funds means (i) Undertakings for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS) domiciled in France, Luxembourg, Ireland and the Netherlands, and (ii) collective investment schemes domiciled in the United Kingdom authorised as UK UCITS.",
          "unit_id":"d97b56331f41a.u17.2556"
        },
        {
          "quote":"The streamlined measures set out in the relevant FAQs will take effect on 28 November 2025 (Effective Date).",
          "unit_id":"d97b56331f41a.u9.1696"
        },
        {
          "quote":"Existing applications received by the SFC before the Effective Date for which no approval or authorisation has been granted will be processed by the SFC in accordance with the existing approval or authorisation process.",
          "unit_id":"d97b56331f41a.u10.1809"
        },
        {
          "quote":"The SFC will continue to conduct post-vetting of scheme changes (including those not subject to the SFC’s prior approval) and related revised documents filed with the SFC.",
          "unit_id":"d97b56331f41a.u12.2069"
        }
      ],
      "distinction":"This reading treats item (ii) as conditional withdrawal of prior approval. A qualifying change receives that relief; an excluded change remains subject to the applicable existing rules, whose exact duty is unavailable. The strongest uncertainty is the transition: its wording expressly preserves application processing but does not resolve withdrawal and resubmission. The packet supports this reading with unresolved questions more strongly than a second complete approval rule.",
      "family":"exceptions",
      "formalization":{
        "facts":[
          {
            "meaning":"The fund is either a UCITS domiciled in France, Luxembourg, Ireland or the Netherlands, or a UK-domiciled collective investment scheme authorised as UK UCITS.",
            "name":"covered_ucits",
            "requires_judgment":true,
            "source_unit_ids":["d97b56331f41a.u17.2556"],
            "type":"bool",
            "unit":"truth value"
          },
          {
            "meaning":"The selected change is a post-authorisation material change to the fund's investment objective, policy or restriction.",
            "name":"covered_material_change",
            "requires_judgment":true,
            "source_unit_ids":["d97b56331f41a.u3.575","d97b56331f41a.u5.840"],
            "type":"bool",
            "unit":"truth value"
          },
          {
            "meaning":"Date for which availability of the circular's approval relief is being assessed; selection of the legally relevant event date remains subject to clarification.",
            "name":"assessment_date",
            "requires_judgment":true,
            "source_unit_ids":["d97b56331f41a.u9.1696"],
            "type":"date",
            "unit":"Gregorian calendar date"
          },
          {
            "meaning":"The selected change complies with the applicable requirements of the fund's home jurisdiction.",
            "name":"home_requirements_met",
            "requires_judgment":true,
            "source_unit_ids":["d97b56331f41a.u5.840"],
            "type":"bool",
            "unit":"truth value"
          },
          {
            "meaning":"The selected change involves novel product features.",
            "name":"novel_features",
            "requires_judgment":true,
            "source_unit_ids":["d97b56331f41a.u5.840"],
            "type":"bool",
            "unit":"truth value"
          },
          {
            "meaning":"The selected change involves complex product features.",
            "name":"complex_features",
            "requires_judgment":true,
            "source_unit_ids":["d97b56331f41a.u5.840"],
            "type":"bool",
            "unit":"truth value"
          },
          {
            "meaning":"The selected change may have local policy implications; this tests possibility rather than established actual effects.",
            "name":"possible_local_policy_implications",
            "requires_judgment":true,
            "source_unit_ids":["d97b56331f41a.u5.840"],
            "type":"bool",
            "unit":"truth value"
          },
          {
            "meaning":"The selected change is the subject of an existing application received by the SFC before 28 November 2025 for which no approval or authorisation had been granted at that date, under the stated transition assumption.",
            "name":"legacy_pending_application",
            "requires_judgment":true,
            "source_unit_ids":["d97b56331f41a.u10.1809"],
            "type":"bool",
            "unit":"truth value"
          }
        ],
        "result":"(and (>= assessment_date (date 2025-11-28)) home_requirements_met (not novel_features) (not complex_features) (not possible_local_policy_implications) (not legacy_pending_application))",
        "result_type":"bool",
        "scope":"(and covered_ucits covered_material_change)"
      },
      "local_id":"reading_1",
      "questions":[
        "Do the revised FAQs add a separate home-supervision test or specify how home compliance must be evidenced?",
        "Can a pending applicant withdraw its application and implement the same change under the new relief?",
        "Which existing provisions determine whether prior approval remains required where this relief is unavailable?"
      ],
      "statement":"[TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] For the selected control, 'eligibility for removal of SFC prior approval under item (ii)', true means an in-scope material investment change satisfies the circular's stated relief conditions under the specified timing assumptions. False means this test does not establish relief; it does not itself establish a prior-approval duty, prohibition, licence possession or non-compliance. Unknown inputs remain unknown. Qualifying changes receive prior-approval relief while remaining subject to applicable notification, filing and post-vetting arrangements.",
      "subject":"Conditional prior-approval relief for one material UCITS investment change"
    }
  ]
}
